environment: Python 3 (python3 -I), Node test runner, glab and gh shims on PATH, no network

cases.title: One glab call for 0, 1, 3 and 50 samples
cases.given: A scratch repo with forge set as the case says and a glab shim that logs cwd and argv
cases.when: read_rules(repo, samples) runs through python3 -I, with the shim first on PATH
cases.then: One call per read_rules. Argv is api projects/:fullpath/push_rule. Cwd is the repo. No branch name reaches argv.
cases.expected: One call per read_rules. Argv is api projects/:fullpath/push_rule. Cwd is the repo. No branch name reaches argv.
cases.actual: One call per read_rules. Argv is api projects/:fullpath/push_rule. Cwd is the repo. No branch name reaches argv. (observed)

evidence.title: public surface (python3 -I import by path)
evidence.inline: def read_rules(repo, samples); def gitlab_rule(body); def github_rule(obj); def make_rule(source, kind, pattern, negate, label); def evaluate(rule, sample); def judge(rules, sample); const RULE_KEYS; const FORGE_TIMEOUT. GH_TIMEOUT is gone and no file uses it.

cases.title: No forge makes no call
cases.given: A scratch repo with forge set as the case says and a glab shim that logs cwd and argv
cases.when: read_rules(repo, samples) runs through python3 -I, with the shim first on PATH

cases.expected: For forge empty, absent, null, 5, [], unknown, config [] or null and no config file: 0 calls from gh and glab shims, no rules, no notes, empty by_sample, unchecked true. A config that is not valid JSON makes read_rules raise Fail, and it makes no call.
cases.actual: For forge empty, absent, null, 5, [], unknown, config [] or null and no config file: 0 calls from gh and glab shims, no rules, no notes, empty by_sample, unchecked true. A config that is not valid JSON makes read_rules raise Fail, and it makes no call. (observed)

seeds.title: read_rules raises Fail on a config that is not valid JSON
seeds.detail: With forge unreadable because config.json is invalid JSON, read_rules raises Fail instead of returning unchecked true. The spec does not define this case. No call is made. The caller must catch Fail.

seeds.title: A failure note is not one line and not bounded
seeds.detail: A multi-line stderr keeps its newlines in the note, and a 100000 character stderr gives a 100025 character note. The spec does not state a limit.

seeds.title: A whitespace-only branch_name_regex gives a rule
seeds.detail: The spec treats only an empty regex as no rule. A regex of spaces becomes a rule that matches names with three spaces.

seeds.title: Public surface adds FORGE_TIMEOUT and gitlab_rule
seeds.detail: Both names are new public names. The plan lists them. No consumer imports them yet. Spec section 3 does not define either.
